supplementary_policy: Only after the main run; require context compatibility and separately frozen SLO. Never silently truncate inputs or invent SLO.
stop_policy: Stop benchmark load on frozen worker/container/process identity change, stale telemetry, OOM, client saturation, stop file, or unexpired residual requests. Never restart model services.
execution_mode: Current retained deployment: Ascend and .58 Iluvatar AWQ graph; MUSA and .60 Iluvatar AWQ eager. This is a mixed-mode system capacity result, not a graph-mode vendor comparison. Embedding uses separate .58 devices and is not part of the AWQ request workload.
scope: Current Ascend/MUSA/Iluvatar native AWQ replicas behind the existing unified Gateway and official round_robin Router. No service/container replacement; no CPU/memory/PID limits.
